need: Hazard row for the DjVu container: the 1920 first printing of Việt Nam sử lược, quyển I is served by Wikimedia Commons as image/vnd.djvu. Zotero's extraction dispatch (fulltext.js, indexItem) handles application/pdf, application/epub+zip and text/* only, so the attachment finishes unindexed, writes no fulltextItems row, and is a declared failure control whose answer_set_participation is 'none' — no row of this printing may be pinned. The text is nevertheless legible page by page on Commons, and a Wikisource transcription of the same work is indexed, so the reader who asks this question in the bank should be answered by the transcription, never by the DjVu.
